target_customer: Independent restaurants, chains and virtual kitchens that sell through several third-party delivery apps
problem: Restaurants juggle a separate tablet for each delivery app and re-key orders into the POS. Cuboh consolidates orders into one tablet and sends them to the POS.
product_category: Restaurant delivery order aggregation and POS integration

founders.name: Juan Jose Orrego
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as the only active founder; background not found in sources opened.

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs integrations with several delivery marketplaces and many POS systems, plus custom tablet software; mostly integration work rather than research.

defensibility.rationale: POS integrations take effort but rivals could build the same; delivery platforms control the order APIs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent is documented as copying it; ChowNow bought Cuboh in March 2024.

market_need_then: Restaurants were adding several delivery apps by 2019 and each brought its own tablet; Cuboh's own copy calls this tablet hell and the seed press said manual order entry into the POS was the pain.

branding.domain_note: Uses cuboh.com; acquisition history not found.

identity.logo: Wordmark and brand mark; brand guide exists, design not described in sources opened
identity.voice_and_tone: Casual and direct, e.g. 'You don't have to live in tablet hell'

brand_strength.rationale: Distinct invented name and punchy copy, but no press or community evidence about the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Cuboh raised a C$1.6M seed in February 2020 and then stayed largely customer funded, saying on its site it had not raised tens of millions. It grew to thousands of restaurants and 14 POS integrations and was bought by ChowNow in March 2024 at an undisclosed price, an exit that fits a capital efficient niche tool absorbed by a larger ordering platform.
notes: Seed was C$1.6M, about US$1.2M per a secondary report; amount_usd left null to avoid converting myself. A dated competitor search found no contemporaneous 2019 coverage naming rivals, so the list is empty. Founder education and prior employers not found. Other founders may exist but only Orrego is on the YC page.
